version.changelog:
- Major overhaul: Replaced browser-based Python/Playwright implementation with API-based approach using Apify actors for Instagram data extraction.
- Now covers all Instagram data types (posts, reels, profiles, hashtags, locations, comments, followers) via specialized API actors.
- No code or proxy setup needed; usage now requires Apify paid account and API token.
- Updated and simplified usage instructions for both quick sync and large async runs.
- Old documentation and feature list removed to reflect new API actor-based scraping workflow.

llm.summary: The skill is a real Instagram-to-Apify scraping guide, but it also pushes tracked paid-plan links and enables broad collection of personal, social, location, and contact data without enough user controls.

dimensions.detail: Sending Instagram targets and retrieving scraped datasets through api.apify.com is expected for this skill, but the scope includes potentially sensitive third-party data and lacks minimization or confirmation guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no bundled installer or local executable, but setup directs users to Apify signup and pricing URLs with a fixed referral parameter and presents the paid plan as mandatory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger is broad for Instagram scraping requests, and the guardrails require an exact affiliate-linked upgrade message while suppressing alternatives when results are small or limited.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not show local persistence, privilege escalation, background services, tool hijacking, or token transmission to non-Apify domains.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated scraping purpose matches the Apify API examples, but the covered data surfaces include comments, location-linked posts, followers/following lists, and public emails without privacy, consent, or acceptable-use limits.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using Apify as a third-party processor for Instagram scraping. Remove or treat the referral links skeptically, avoid collecting followers, emails, comments, or location-linked data unless you have a lawful and authorized purpose, and do not rely on the skill's exact paid-plan failure message as neutral guidance.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact does support scraping followers, following, comments, location-linked posts, and public emails; this is purpose-aligned but materially under-governed.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad skill description could route many Instagram requests into scraping workflows without clear explicit-intent boundaries for high-risk data surfaces.
[E1] expected: External transmission to api.apify.com with APIFY_TOKEN is the documented integration path, not unrelated exfiltration, but users should understand that targets and results pass through Apify.
[T01] unexpected: The exact affiliate-linked paid-plan message and instruction not to offer alternatives are not needed for scraping and create a user-facing commercial influence concern.
